title: Fixed-base portal frame with a stiff span under uniform load: joint rotation and largest moment

source.work: ANSYS, Inc., Mechanical APDL Verification Manual (public help site ansyshelp.ansys.com)
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text; the sketch was not readable). The page cites: N. J. Hoff, The Analysis of Structures, 1956, pp. 115-119 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'Target' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Portal: columns of 400 in with I = 20,300 in^4, span of 800 in with I = 5 x 20,300 in^4, E = 30e6 psi, 500 lb/in downward on the span. Column bases built in: the sketch was not readable, but the two formulas the page gives for its targets (rotation = w a^3 / (27 E I_col), largest moment = (19/54) w a^2) hold for built-in bases only (pinned bases give (3/8) w a^2 at midspan). The formulas neglect axial and shear deformation; the model follows them: every member A = 1e7 in^2, no shear deformation (the page's program model with finite area and shear deformation differs from its own targets by 9 % and 2 %). Targets: rotation of the beam-column joint, moment at midspan of the span. Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
